scorecard.rationale: A healthy-adult ginger extract trial had an inconclusive mechanical shoulder-hardness contrast and a favorable subjective subgroup. The Parkinson formula reports and isolated mouse constituents do not isolate grated ginger or show the direction of clinical rigidity. Ginger-PD has no posted item estimates. The 6-shogaol adjunct mouse experiment reports a gut motility improvement without added pole-test motor improvement and does not rate rigidity. The recruiting Ginger-PD registry still has no posted outcomes and lists biomarker outcomes rather than a separate rigidity result.
